card.name: Words leading into success or survival
card.fires_on: Words like chance, probability, unlikely or doomed that come just before an expected outcome such as success, survival or cure. Also linking words (of, to, if) in the same spot.

modes.label: Chance of outcome
modes.description: The word chance or probability right before a mention of surviving or being successful.
modes.example: have a greater<< chance>> of being successful

modes.label: Likelihood words and links
modes.description: Words like unlikely, doomed, are or of that set up whether a result will succeed or survive.
modes.example: are highly<< unlikely>> to achieve SVR

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning success, succeed and winning.
card.plain: It fires on words that set up whether something will work out, like chance of success or survival.
